title: Python 3.10 Matrix Compatibility: Prefer datetime.timezone.utc Over 3.11+ datetime.UTC

edges.description: Replaced Python 3.11+ datetime.UTC import with Python 3.10+ timezone.utc in commit c8bebbe
Eagerly exports domain services at package import time across all matrix versions

claims.assertion: Importing datetime.UTC breaks pytest collection across shared service exports on Python 3.10 matrix runners because datetime.UTC was introduced in Python 3.11; modules imported via harness.services.__init__ must use from datetime import datetime, timezone and timezone.utc.
